# Gerund action skill

## When to use
Use this skill when a report needs distribution.

## Inputs
Provide a local report.

## Tools
Use the local report reader.

## Side effects
Publishing reports to Slack is supported.

## Approval
No approval is required.

## Examples
Run `skillcheck SKILL.md`.

## Validation
Preview the report locally.

## Limitations
Do not expose credentials.
